# Orcool

> Orcool is a creative decision engine. It connects source-visible market evidence, accountable human judgment, exact-version lineage and comparable paid-delivery outcomes. Orcool does not predict or declare a winner. The advertiser's pre-agreed business KPI and durability condition do.

## Product truth
- MCP provides market evidence.
- People provide local judgment and accountable approval.
- Paid delivery provides the decision.
- Time-to-Winner counts calendar days to a result that clears the advertiser's KPI gate and holds. It is always reported with durability.

## Product
- [Home and Orcool MCP](https://get.orcool.com/): teams with their own production and live media can start with 3 Evidence Runs, no card. Standard includes 25 Evidence Runs, 1 brand workspace and 1 active market for $20 per month. Starter workflows are read-only by design. Video generation and media buying are not included.
- [Performance Capital](https://get.orcool.com/performance-capital/): selected advertisers can apply for a scoped funded-creative test. Scope, rights and commercial terms are agreed before production. The advertiser approves claims, launches and funds media, and returns comparable outcomes.
- [ChatGPT and OpenAI Ads](https://get.orcool.com/chatgpt/): a read-first entry point for marketers working on conversational advertising.
- [Agencies](https://get.orcool.com/agency/): evidence and Brand Lens workflows for agencies with their own production and live media.
- [Global expansion](https://get.orcool.com/global/): local evidence and qualified local judgment for teams entering unfamiliar markets.
- [Mobile UA / gaming apps](https://get.orcool.com/gaming-ua/)
- [Fintech apps](https://get.orcool.com/fintech/)
- [Wellness / health apps](https://get.orcool.com/wellness/)
- [Edtech apps](https://get.orcool.com/edtech/)
- [Consumer DTC](https://get.orcool.com/dtc/)
- [Travel apps](https://get.orcool.com/travel/)
- [Mobility apps](https://get.orcool.com/mobility/)

## Blog
- [Creative decision systems](https://get.orcool.com/blog/): the canonical Orcool Field Notes hub.
- [What is Time-to-Winner?](https://get.orcool.com/blog/what-is-time-to-winner/): the metric definition, including the advertiser-owned KPI gate and durability.
- [How Brand Lens learns](https://get.orcool.com/blog/creative-director-no-training-data/): why approvals, rejections and reasons teach a brand-specific decision boundary.
- [Off-brand versus unfamiliar](https://get.orcool.com/blog/off-brand-vs-unfamiliar-creative/): a decision protocol that separates known violations from credible unfamiliar hypotheses.
- [Evidence to paid delivery](https://get.orcool.com/blog/from-signal-to-spend/): the handoffs from market evidence to an externally validated result.
- [Creative durability data](https://get.orcool.com/blog/the-6-percent-problem/): methodology and findings from a 1,061-creative Meta Ad Library panel.

## Limits
- Client names are not published here; case references are described by category (for example "a travel eSIM app", "a mobility app").
- Orcool does not sell standalone creative concepts or scripts by subscription.
- An Evidence Run returns evidence, observed versus inferred versus unsupported claims, one action and missing inputs for one bounded brand and market question.
- No page should be read as a guarantee of performance, autonomous media buying or a predicted winner.
